Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Real-time engagement notification system checkpoint 1

Complete implementation of delta-based engagement tracking:

Backend:
- MonitoringEngagement model for storing all engager data
- MonitoringNotification model with status workflow \(generated/edited/sent/skipped\)
- Delta calculator for fetching only new engagers based on metric changes
- Deletion tracker to detect and mark deleted engagements \(no alerts\)
- Notification generator with LLM support for replies/quotes, templates for retweets/likes

API Endpoints:
- GET/PATCH /api/monitor-tweet/[tweetId]/settings - configure thresholds and Slack webhook
- GET /api/monitor-tweet/[tweetId]/engagers - list engagers with filters
- GET /api/monitor-tweet/[tweetId]/notifications - list notifications by status
- GET/PATCH /api/monitor-tweet/[tweetId]/notifications/[id] - view/edit/skip notifications
- POST /api/monitor-tweet/[tweetId]/notifications/send - send to Slack

Frontend:
- /monitor/[tweetId]/engagers - engager dashboard with filters, sorting, CSV export
- /monitor/[tweetId]/notifications - creative director review UI with inline editing

Cron Enhancement:
- check-monitors now processes realtime engagers when enabled
- Ranks engagers and generates notifications for high-importance ones
- Tracks deletions silently without alerting

Note: Likes tracking deferred \(requires OAuth setup\)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
